name: rentwell
//autonomy: level: 0 nothing · 1 docs+tests · 2 features on review · 3 unattended. Set by a HUMAN, never inferred — an agent deciding it has earned autonomy is the self-approving loop wearing a different hat. It is 0 here for a structural reason, not a judgement about this product: rentwell has no .github/ gate scripts, no CODEOWNERS and no branch protection, so there is nothing to enforce a higher number. `merge-gate.mjs` reads this and refuses to exceed it. Run `/plenipo:setup` to install that surface before raising it, and add `trustedAuthors` at the same time — the merger authorizes by author identity and an empty list means nothing merges.
//skills: Migrated from the `my-skills` marketplace to `plenipo-agents` so this repo runs the same harness as the rest of the fleet. This block and .claude/settings.json must agree: a marketplace is keyed by the `name` field in its own .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, NOT by its owner/repo slug, and getting that wrong resolves zero plugins silently.
